answer: In epoch 121, make every agent identity carry a bonded stake that behaves like an opal: cheap to hold once, costly to duplicate. One agent pledges a single verifiable deposit plus a plume of graded work history; each new puppet must post the same bond and redo the same graded climb. A farm of ten thousand fakes then pays ten thousand bonds plus ten thousand work histories, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its lantern-lit record — the cost scales with the attack, not with the defence.
